notes.title: Update V 1.3
notes.content:
[h1]Update V 1.3[/h1]

[h2]General[/h2]
In the lobby when switching between menu and play mode, the chat history is no longer deleted.
Statistics - bugs fixed.
Swedish inserted. (other languages will follow)
Escape Route 3 is now available.

[h2]Player[/h2]
[list]
[*] A new character "Tatjana".
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39061373/c544a4b2c26d7e216415e9a71db767b0db56b479.png[/img]
[*] Everyone can now help everyone without a first aid kit. But there are only 1000 points instead of 2000.
[/list]

[h2]Maps[/h2]
[list]
[*] Hotel Marble - bugs fixed.
[*] Hotel New Overlook - bugs fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Release V1.0
notes.content:
[b]Version 1.0 is now released! There is a new map, a new monster and a new level of environmental interaction. [/b]

[h2]Welcome to Spencer Mansion 2[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39061373/df15acbe9fa693e4f480bfd14d577a7cbc03b2ea.png[/img]

[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*] Better interaction with the environment by opening cupboards and drawers.
[*] Bug fixes.
[/list]

[h2]Maps[/h2]
[list]
[*] A new map added (Spencer Mansion 2).
[*] All maps revised.
[*] Improved performance.
[*] Bug fixes.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39061373/4ac438da77a045b22bffde2bd06044ec956ed6d2.png[/img]

[h2]Monster[/h2]
[list]
[*] New monster added.
[*] Monsters with different properties.
[*] AI improved.
[/list]

notes.title: Narrow Escape V 0.14
notes.content:
[h1]Narrow Escape V 0.14[/h1]

[b]Monsters[/b]
[list]
[*] A new monster has been added.
[*] Monsters can now duck.
[*] Small texture improvements made.
[*] Re-edited monster sounds.
[/list]

[b]Players[/b]
[list]
[*] Players can now help each other as long as they have a first aid kit with them.
[*] Every help is rewarded with 2000 points.
[*] Players have 2 minutes to help the injured player.
[/list]

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] Made small texture improvements to the buildings.
[*] Every building got at least 3 surveillance cameras. If a player escapes or dies, they can switch through the cameras and continue to watch the game.
[*] Added more sound effects.
[*] A new titel music added.
[*] User interface improved.
[*] Added tips in loading screen.
[*] Pickgun: Bugs fixed.
[/list]

tags.feature: A new monster has been added.
Players can now help each other as long as they have a first aid kit with them.
Every building got at least 3 surveillance cameras. If a player escapes or dies, they can switch through the cameras and continue to watch the game.
